title: HUD Blue Spec - The Real Direction
summary: BLUE HUD. Not warm amber. VEGAS oversized energy. Trello thickness. Crossy Road bounce. 18-20px minimum. This replaces all previous HUD color direction.
content:
HUD Blue Spec: The Real Direction

Steffen | 2026-03-16 This supersedes ALL previous HUD specs. Blue, not amber.

THE DIRECTION CHANGE

Previous spec said warm amber HUD. That's DEAD.

Patrik's directive:

  • BLUE HUD. Fresh, game energy. Not warm amber.
  • VEGAS oversized energy. Everything feels BIG, bold, confident.
  • Trello thickness. Cards have weight. Nothing feels thin or delicate.
  • Crossy Road bounce. Everything has spring physics. Nothing is static.
  • 18-20px minimum font size. Not 14-15px. Not 11px. EIGHTEEN MINIMUM.
  • "Old people can read em, young people love em."
  • Building should float/breathe. Subtle ambient animation. Alive.
  • Side menu = larger, game-like. Not a compact web sidebar.

Color System: BLUE

The blue contrasts with the warm orange/amber of the office interior. The HUD is the FRAME. The office is the PAINTING. Cool frame, warm painting.

Primary Blue Palette

Token Hex Usage
hud-bg #0F1B2D Main HUD background. Deep navy blue.
hud-bg-light #162236 Cards, elevated surfaces.
hud-border #1E3A5F Borders, dividers. Visible but not harsh.
hud-accent #3B82F6 Primary accent. Buttons, active states, progress bars.
hud-accent-bright #60A5FA Hover states, highlights, glow effects.
hud-accent-glow rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) Glow effects, subtle accent washes.
hud-text-primary #F1F5F9 Primary text. Near-white, high contrast.
hud-text-secondary #94A3B8 Secondary text. Slate-400. Still readable.
hud-success #22C55E Agent done, task complete.
hud-warning #F59E0B Agent blocked, attention needed.
hud-danger #EF4444 Error, critical alert.

Blue Gradient for HUD Strip

background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0F1B2D 0%, #162236 100%);
border-top: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

Agent Color Dots on Blue

Agent signature colors POP against blue. Every agent dot, portrait ring, and status indicator uses the agent's signature color on the blue background. High saturation. No muting.

Typography: VEGAS OVERSIZED

"Old people can read em, young people love em."

Font Sizes (MINIMUM ENFORCED)

Element Size Weight Notes
Project card title 20px 700 (Bold) THE most important text in the HUD. Must command attention.
Agent name 18px 600 (SemiBold) Below portrait. Always readable at a glance.
Task count badge 16px 700 (Bold) Inside colored pill. Number must pop.
Status text 16px 500 (Medium) "3 active, 2 done" etc.
Progress bar label 16px 600 (SemiBold) Next to the progress bar.
Chat input text 18px 400 (Regular) What you type should be easy to read.
Chat placeholder 18px 400 (Regular) "Talk to Bobby..."
Notification text 16px 500 (Medium) Alerts, updates, blockers.
Timestamp 14px 400 (Regular) ONLY element allowed below 16px. Timestamps only.

Font: System game stack

font-family: 'Inter', 'SF Pro Display', system-ui, sans-serif;

Inter at these sizes with proper weight is chunky, modern, game-UI quality. Not pixel font (we're past that). Not thin sans-serif. Confident thickness.

VEGAS Energy Rules

  • ALL text has slight letter-spacing: letter-spacing: 0.01em for body, 0.02em for labels
  • Numbers use tabular figures: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
  • Important numbers (task counts, progress %) get oversized treatment: 24-28px
  • Status words ("ACTIVE", "DONE", "BLOCKED") are uppercase, 14px, letter-spacing 0.08em, bold

Card Design: TRELLO THICKNESS

Cards have WEIGHT. They feel like physical objects.

Card Specs

.hud-card {
  background: #162236;
  border: 2px solid #1E3A5F;          /* 2px, not 1px. Trello weight. */
  border-radius: 12px;                 /* Generous radius. Friendly. */
  padding: 16px;                       /* Breathing room inside. */
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),     /* Depth shadow */
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); /* Subtle top highlight */
  min-height: 80px;                    /* Cards have presence. Not thin strips. */
}

.hud-card:hover {
  border-color: #3B82F6;
  transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    0 4px 16px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15),
    0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); /* Crossy Road spring */
}

Card Content Layout

+------------------------------------------+
|  [Agent Avatar 48px]  Project Name  20px |
|                       3/7 tasks     16px |
|  [====-------]  42%                 16px |
|  Status: ACTIVE       Bobby         18px |
+------------------------------------------+

Avatar is 48px. Not 32px. GAME SIZE. The portrait should be recognizable without squinting.

Agent Portraits: 48px with Signature Ring

.agent-portrait {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid var(--agent-color);  /* 3px ring in agent signature color */
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--agent-color-glow);
}

.agent-portrait:hover {
  transform: scale(1.15) translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--agent-color-glow);
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

Agent Row (Status Strip)

The agent row at the top or left of the HUD shows ALL agents at a glance.

[Bobby 48px] [Elon 48px] [Cleo 48px] [Steffen 48px] ...
  ACTIVE       ACTIVE      DONE        ACTIVE

Each portrait has:

  • 3px signature color ring
  • Status dot (10px, bottom-right): green/amber/red
  • Name below: 18px, agent color
  • Hover: bounce up with spring physics

Side Menu: GAME-LIKE, NOT WEB SIDEBAR

The side menu should feel like a game pause menu or inventory screen. NOT a narrow web sidebar with small text.

Side Menu Specs

Property Value Why
Width 320-400px WIDE. Game menu, not settings panel.
Background #0F1B2D Same blue as HUD.
Border-left 2px solid #1E3A5F Thick Trello border.
Item height 56-64px Each menu item is a BUTTON, not a text link.
Item font size 20px VEGAS. Readable across the room.
Item padding 16px 24px Generous. Each item breathes.
Icon size 28px Visible icons next to text. Not decorative 14px icons.
Active indicator 4px left border in #3B82F6 Like a game menu cursor.

Menu Items

+-------------------------------------------+
|                                           |
|  [Icon 28px]  Dashboard          20px    |
|  [Icon 28px]  Agents             20px    |
|  [Icon 28px]  Projects           20px    |
|  [Icon 28px]  Checklist          20px    |
|  [Icon 28px]  Store              20px    |
|  [Icon 28px]  Settings           20px    |
|                                           |
|  --- QUICK STATS ---              14px    |
|  Active: 4    Done: 2            18px    |
|  Tasks: 12/31                    18px    |
|                                           |
+-------------------------------------------+

Hover on any item: slight bounce right (translateX(4px)) with spring physics. Active item has blue glow behind it.

Building Animation: FLOATING / BREATHING

The building should never feel dead. Even at idle, it breathes.

Floating Animation

@keyframes building-breathe {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-4px); }
}

.building-container {
  animation: building-breathe 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

4px vertical movement over 6 seconds. Subtle. You notice it subconsciously. The building is alive.

Room Window Glow Pulse

Each room's window glow pulses independently at slightly different rates:

@keyframes window-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { opacity: 0.9; }
}

.room-bobby .window-glow { animation: window-pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.room-elon .window-glow { animation: window-pulse 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.room-steffen .window-glow { animation: window-pulse 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; }

Different periods prevent synchronization. Looks organic.

CORNER Sign Glow

The CORNER sign on the building pulses brighter than windows:

@keyframes sign-glow {
  0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 216, 122, 0.6); }
  50% { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 216, 122, 0.9), 0 0 40px rgba(255, 183, 77, 0.3); }
}

Chat Input: BLUE, NOT AMBER

The chat input lives in the HUD. The HUD is blue. The chat input is blue.

.chat-input {
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.06);
  border: 2px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #F1F5F9;
  min-height: 52px;
}

.chat-input::placeholder {
  color: #64748B;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.chat-input:focus {
  border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08);
}

Placeholder text: "Talk to Bobby..." (conversational, game-like, not "Message Bobby...")

Progress Bars: CHUNKY

.progress-bar {
  height: 12px;                       /* Thick. Visible. */
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #1E3A5F;               /* Track: dark blue */
}

.progress-bar-fill {
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3B82F6, #60A5FA);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
  transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); /* Spring! */
}

Crossy Road Spring Physics Reference

All interactive elements use this timing:

/* Standard bounce */
transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

/* Framer Motion equivalent */
spring: { stiffness: 500, damping: 15 }

/* Hover states */
cards: scale(1.02), translateY(-2px)
portraits: scale(1.15), translateY(-3px)
menu items: translateX(4px)
buttons: scale(1.05)

/* Click/tap */
all: scale(0.96) then release to normal with spring

What This KILLS From Previous Specs

  1. Warm amber HUD -> BLUE HUD
  2. 14-15px project names -> 20px project names
  3. 11-12px badges -> 16px badges
  4. 32px agent portraits -> 48px agent portraits
  5. Compact web sidebar -> 320-400px game menu
  6. Thin 1px borders -> 2px Trello borders
  7. Static building -> Floating/breathing building
  8. rgba(255,183,77) amber chat -> rgba(59,130,246) blue chat

For Bobby: Implementation Priority

  1. Swap HUD palette to blue. All amber/warm tokens become blue tokens. 30 min.
  2. Bump ALL font sizes. Nothing below 16px except timestamps. 15 min.
  3. Thicken borders. 1px -> 2px everywhere in HUD. 10 min.
  4. Add building breathe animation. 6s translateY cycle. 5 min.
  5. Enlarge agent portraits. 32px -> 48px with 3px signature ring. 15 min.
  6. Widen side menu. Current width -> 320-400px. Enlarge all items. 20 min.
  7. Chat input blue treatment. Swap amber for blue background/border. 10 min.

Total estimate: ~2 hours if done in sequence. Bobby can ship items 1-4 in one commit.

This is the HUD north star now. Blue, oversized, thick, bouncy, alive.
